parameters.description:
Optional header to select the Workspace for this request. The value is a Workspace ID (for example, `wrkspc_011CZkZaBF1tNoB5wlCeusgy`).

Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace.
parameters.name: anthropic-workspace-id

400.description: Invalid argument - The client specified an invalid argument

401.description: Unauthenticated - The request does not have valid authentication credentials

403.description: Permission denied - The caller does not have permission to execute the specified operation

404.description: Not found - Some requested entity was not found

408.description: Deadline exceeded - The deadline expired before the operation could complete

409.description: Aborted - The operation was aborted due to concurrency issue

412.description: Failed precondition - Operation was rejected because the system is not in required state

413.description: Out of range - Operation was attempted past the valid range

429.description: Resource exhausted - Some resource has been exhausted (rate limiting)

431.description: Request header fields too large - Request metadata was too large

499.description: Cancelled - The operation was cancelled by the client

501.description: Unimplemented - The operation is not implemented or supported

503.description: Unavailable - The service is currently unavailable

504.description: Deadline exceeded - Upstream service did not respond in time

AnthropicBeta.description:
Beta names you can send in the `anthropic-beta` header.

See [Beta headers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers) for how to send them and where to find the name a feature needs.

agent.name: My First Agent
agent.system: You are a general-purpose agent that can research, write code, run commands, and use connected tools to complete the user's task end to end.

outcome_evaluations.explanation: All five sections present with inline citations.

examples.name: My First Agent
examples.system: You are a general-purpose agent that can research, write code, run commands, and use connected tools to complete the user's task end to end.

archived_at.description: When the session was archived. Null if not archived.

budget.description: The session's enforced spend ceiling, or null when no budget is set.

deployment_id.description: Deployment ID when the session was created from a deployment reference. Null otherwise.

outcome_evaluations.description: Per-outcome evaluation state. One entry per `define_outcome` event sent to the session.

examples.explanation: All five sections present with inline citations.

usage.description: Cumulative token usage for the session.

vault_ids.description: Vault IDs attached to the session at creation. Empty when no vaults were supplied.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionAgent.description: Resolved `agent` definition for a `session`. Snapshot of the `agent` at `session` creation time.

example.name: My First Agent
example.system: You are a general-purpose agent that can research, write code, run commands, and use connected tools to complete the user's task end to end.

execution_identity.description: Execution principal snapshotted from the agent at session creation. Always present; `{"type": "service_account"}` when runs carry no customer-named principal.

multiagent.description: Resolved multiagent orchestration configuration. Null when the agent is single-threaded.

examples: You are a general-purpose agent that can research, write code, run commands, and use connected tools to complete the user's task end to end.

BetaManagedAgentsBudget.description: An enforced spend ceiling on a session. Discriminated on `type`; `limit` is the only kind currently supported.

BetaManagedAgentsOutcomeEvaluationResour.description: Evaluation state for a single outcome defined via a `define_outcome` event.

example.explanation: All five sections present with inline citations.

completed_at.description: When the outcome reached a terminal result. Null while `pending`/`running`/`evaluating`.

explanation.description: Grader's verdict text from the most recent evaluation. For `satisfied`, explains why criteria are met; for `needs_revision` (intermediate), what's missing; for `failed`, why unrecoverable.
examples: All five sections present with inline citations.

iteration.description: 0-indexed revision cycle the outcome is currently on.

outcome_id.description: Server-generated outc_ ID for this outcome.

result.description: Current evaluation state. `pending` before the agent begins work; `running` while producing or revising; `evaluating` while the grader scores; `satisfied`/`max_iterations_reached`/`failed`/`interrupted` are terminal.

active_seconds.description: Cumulative time in seconds the session spent in `running` status. Excludes idle time.

duration_seconds.description: Elapsed time since session creation in seconds. For terminated sessions, frozen at the final update.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsage.description: Cumulative token usage for a session across all turns.

active_seconds.description: Cumulative time in seconds during which the session had at least one thread in running status. Overlapping activity from concurrent threads is counted once, unlike `stats.active_seconds`, which sums each thread's own active time. This is the duration the session's runtime cost is priced on.

cache_creation.description: Tokens used to create prompt cache entries, broken down by cache TTL.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Total tokens read from prompt cache.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens consumed across all turns.

list_cost.description: Cumulative list cost of the session across all turns, priced at public list rates. Absent until cost tracking is available for the session.

output_tokens.description: Total output tokens generated across all turns.

server_tool_use.description: Cumulative server-executed tool usage across all turns. Absent until server-tool tracking is available for the session.

BetaManagedAgentsExecutionIdentity.description: Execution principal for runs of this agent as returned in API responses.

BetaManagedAgentsMCPServer.description: Union type for MCP server connection definitions returned in API responses.

effort.description: How hard Claude works on each inference call. One of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`. Always present; resolved to the per-model default at save time when not supplied.

inference_geo.description: Geographic region for model inference. When unset, requests fall through to the workspace's default_inference_geo.

speed.description: Inference speed mode. `fast` provides significantly faster output token generation at premium pricing. Defaults to `standard`. Not all models support `fast`; invalid combinations are rejected at create time.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagent.description: Resolved multiagent orchestration configuration as returned on a `session`.

BetaManagedAgentsSkill.description: Resolved skill as returned in API responses.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentTool.description: Union type for tool configurations returned in API responses.

BetaManagedAgentsBudgetLimit.description: A hard spend ceiling. The session stops issuing new model requests once the tracked list cost reaches `max_list_cost`.

max_list_cost.description: Maximum list cost the session may accrue. List price is used regardless of any negotiated discount, so the cap fires at or before the actual charge.

BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreResource.description: A memory store attached to an agent session.

access.description: Access mode for the mounted store. Defaults to `read_write`. `read_only` mounts the store as a read-only filesystem.

description.description: Description of the memory store, snapshotted at attach time. Rendered into the agent's system prompt. Empty string when the store has no description.

instructions.description: Per-attachment guidance for the agent on how to use this store. Rendered into the memory section of the system prompt. Max 4096 chars.

memory_store_id.description: The memory store ID (memstore_...). Must belong to the caller's organization and workspace.

mount_path.description: Filesystem path where the store is mounted in the session container, e.g. /mnt/memory/user-preferences. Derived from the store's name. Output-only.

name.description: Display name of the memory store, snapshotted at attach time. Later edits to the store's name do not propagate to this resource.

BetaManagedAgentsCacheCreationUsage.description: Prompt-cache creation token usage broken down by cache lifetime.

ephemeral_1h_input_tokens.description: Tokens used to create 1-hour ephemeral cache entries.

ephemeral_5m_input_tokens.description: Tokens used to create 5-minute ephemeral cache entries.

BetaMonetaryAmount.description: A monetary amount in a specific currency.

amount.description: Amount in minor units of the currency, as an integer decimal string with no leading zeros: "2500" is $25.00 and "50" is fifty cents. A string rather than a number so no float rounding is ever applied.

currency.description: Uppercase ISO-4217 currency code. `USD` is the only currency currently supported; the accepted set is closed and grows only when a new currency is priced.

BetaManagedAgentsServerToolUsage.description: Cumulative count of server-executed tool invocations, broken down by tool.

web_fetch_requests.description: Number of server-executed web fetch requests.

web_search_requests.description: Number of server-executed web search requests.

BetaManagedAgentsAwsRoleExecutionIdentit.description: An AWS IAM role principal as returned in API responses.

BetaManagedAgentsServiceAccountExecution.description: The Anthropic-managed service account as returned in API responses.

BetaManagedAgentsMCPServerURLDefinition.description: URL-based MCP server connection as returned in API responses.

BetaManagedAgentsEffort.description: How hard Claude works on each turn. Sets `output_config.effort` on every Messages call the session makes.

BetaManagedAgentsEffortLow.description: Low effort. Favors latency over reasoning depth.

BetaManagedAgentsEffortMedium.description: Medium effort. Balances latency and reasoning depth.

BetaManagedAgentsEffortXhigh.description: Extra-high effort. Not all models accept this level.

BetaManagedAgentsEffortMax.description: Maximum effort. Favors reasoning depth over latency.

BetaManagedAgentsMultiagentAdvisor.description: Whether the session's primary thread can consult an advisor model.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentWorkfl.description: Whether the agent can start workflow runs.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolConfigUnion.description: Configuration for a specific agent tool.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolsetDefaultConf.description: Resolved default configuration for agent tools.

BetaManagedAgentsMCPToolConfig.description: Resolved configuration for a specific MCP tool.

BetaManagedAgentsMCPToolsetDefaultConfig.description: Resolved default configuration for all tools from an MCP server.

BetaManagedAgentsCustomToolInputSchema.description: JSON Schema for custom tool input parameters.

sha.description: Full commit SHA to check out.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadAgent.description: Resolved `agent` definition for a single `session_thread`. Snapshot of the agent at thread creation time. The multiagent roster is not repeated here; read it from `Session.agent`.

example.name: Researcher
example.system: You are a research subagent that gathers and summarises sources for the coordinating agent.

execution_identity.description: Execution principal snapshotted from the agent at session creation. Always present; `{"type": "service_account"}` when runs carry no customer-named principal.

examples: You are a research subagent that gathers and summarises sources for the coordinating agent.

BetaManagedAgentsAdvisor.description: Platform advisor roster entry: a model the session's primary thread may consult mid-turn.

BetaManagedAgentsMultiagentAdvisorEnable.description: The session's primary thread can consult `model` mid-turn.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentSubage.description: The agent can spawn session threads.

inline_agents.description: Whether the agent can define inline agents, which are not saved, when it spawns session threads.

predefined_agents.description: Full `agent` definitions of the predefined agents, which are saved agents that this agent can spawn as session threads.

BetaManagedAgentsMultiagentSubagentsDisa.description: The agent cannot spawn session threads.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionMultiagentWorkfl.description: The agent can start workflow runs.

inline_agents.description: Whether a run's plan can define inline agents, which are not saved.

predefined_agents.description: Full `agent` definitions of the predefined agents, which are saved agents that a run's plan can use.

BetaManagedAgentsMultiagentWorkflowsDisa.description: The agent cannot start workflow runs.

url_sources.description: Which sources contribute URLs the tool may fetch, always in the object form. Null when not set, which allows every source.

BetaManagedAgentsMultiagentInlineAgents.description: Whether the agent can define inline agents. The agent defines an inline agent itself, in a workflow run's plan or when it spawns a session thread, and the inline agent is not saved.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSources.description: Which sources contribute URLs the web_fetch tool may fetch. A key that is null was not set and allows every URL from that source.

client_tool_results.description: Which custom tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched. Null when not set, which allows every custom tool's results.

server_tool_results.description: Which of the web_search and web_fetch tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched. Null when not set, which allows both.

user_input.description: Whether URLs in the text of user messages may be fetched. Null when not set, which allows them.

BetaManagedAgentsUserLocation.description: Approximate user location for search result localization.

BetaManagedAgentsAlwaysAllowPolicy.description: Tool calls are automatically approved without user confirmation.

BetaManagedAgentsAlwaysAskPolicy.description: Tool calls require user confirmation before execution.

BetaManagedAgentsAutoPolicy.description: The server decides each tool call individually: it judges, from the tool, its input, and the session content so far, whether the call is safe to execute or high-risk, and evaluates it to allow when judged safe and to deny when judged high-risk. A call the server cannot reach a judgement on evaluates to ask.

BetaManagedAgentsMultiagentInlineAgentsE.description: The agent can define inline agents.

BetaManagedAgentsMultiagentInlineAgentsD.description: The agent cannot define inline agents.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceToolFi.description: Which tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceUserIn.description: Whether URLs in the text of user messages may be fetched.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceAll.description: Every URL from this source may be fetched. This is the default.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceNone.description: This source contributes no URLs that may be fetched.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceOnly.description: Only the named tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched.

tools.description: The tools whose results contribute. Between 1 and 128 entries, each with a different name. An empty list is rejected; use "none" to allow no tool's results.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceExcept.description: Every tool's results contribute URLs that may be fetched, except the named tools' results.

tools.description: The tools whose results do not contribute. Between 1 and 128 entries, each with a different name. An empty list is rejected; use "all" to leave out no tool's results.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceToolRe.description: Names one tool in an only or except list.

name.description: Name of the tool. Compared exactly, so upper and lower case letters are different.
